name: power-interview-admin
description: Convenience root for the admin dashboard - runs the FastAPI service and the Next.js UI together

scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "uv run python -m app.main" "pnpm --dir web start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "uv run python -m app.main" "pnpm --dir web dev"
